description.text:
Fearless Terastal (无畏太晶) was a Scarlet & Violet booster in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 16 May 2025 in 5-card packs with one holo and 20-card packs with six. It brought Terastallization to the Chinese game as Tera Pokémon ex: each is marked Tera (太晶) under its HP and takes no damage from attacks while on the Bench. Tera Arcanine ex, with 280 HP, is on its cover, and Forretress ex and Gyarados ex are Tera too.

Paldea's four Legendary Treasures of Ruin, Wo-Chien ex, Chi-Yu ex, Chien-Pao ex and Ting-Lu ex, came with it, as did Baxcalibur, Mimikyu, the Supporters Grusha, Iono and Giacomo, Superior Energy Retrieval, Big Air Balloon and the Stadiums Calamitous Snowy Mountain and Calamitous Wasteland. Common, Uncommon and Rare cards also come as Poké Ball pattern and Master Ball pattern holos. The Happy Set Lucario & Greninja & Zamazenta & Mabosstiff came out the same day. Its main cards are numbered out of 130; Art Rare, full-art, Special Art Rare and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 165.
